title: Unit 11 Test
subtitle: can / can’t · abilities · requests · adverbs (well, fast…)

sections.title: A. Look at the table. Complete the sentences with can or can’t.
sections.passage: ABILITIES — Javohir: swim ✓ · drive ✗ · cook ✓ · play the guitar ✗ | Sabina: swim ✗ · drive ✓ · cook ✓ · play the guitar ✓

items.q: Javohir ______ swim.
Sabina ______ swim.
Javohir ______ drive.
Sabina ______ drive.
Javohir and Sabina ______ cook.
Javohir ______ play the guitar.

sections.title: B. Write questions with Can. Then choose the short answer.

items.q: Sabina / play the guitar
Javohir / drive
Can Sabina drive?
Can Javohir play the guitar?

o: They can play chess very well.
They can play very well chess.
They very well can play chess.
They can very well play chess.

sections.title: D. Make requests. Use Can I … ? or Can you … ?

items.q: You want to open the window. → ______ open the window?
You want your friend to help you. → ______ help me?
You want to use your teacher’s pen. → ______ use your pen?
You want the waiter to bring water. → ______ bring some water, please?
He’s a fast runner. He runs ______.
She’s a good singer. She sings ______.
It’s a slow car. It goes ______.
He’s a careful driver. He drives ______.
She’s a quiet speaker. She speaks ______.

sections.title: F. Read the text and answer the questions.
sections.passage: Mohira is only twelve, but she can do a lot of things. She can speak three languages: Uzbek, Russian, and English. She can play the piano very well, and last year she won a music competition in Tashkent. She can’t swim yet, but she wants to learn this summer. Her brother can swim, but he can’t play any musical instruments.

items.q: How many languages can Mohira speak?
Mohira can play the piano.
Mohira can swim very well.
Her brother can play the guitar.
What did she win last year?
